```python
def _group_by_module(statistics: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]) ->Dict[str,
    Dict[str, Any]]:
    out_stats: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = defaultdict(dict)
    for stat_name, mod_stats in statistics.items():
        for mod_name, value in mod_stats.items():
            out_stats[mod_name][stat_name] = value
    return dict(out_stats)
```
